create_warc_reader: create a WarcReader instance to read WARC files from a data folder path
read_warc_file: read a WARC file and yield each record as a separate document with text and metadata
process_warc_record: process a WARC record to extract html content, record id, url, and date metadata
filter_warc_content_type: filter WARC records by mime type to include only text/html and application/xhtml+xml
decode_warc_charset: decode WARC record content bytes using UTF-8 with cchardet fallback for non-UTF-8 encodings
